neutral_background: a plain, indeterminate, heavily blurred background

environment_relations.grass: objects rest on or beside the selected grassy region
environment_relations.cedarwood: objects rest on or beside the selected cedarwood form
environment_relations.lavender: objects sit beside the selected lavender patch, not inside the flower spikes

generic_object_relation: objects form one coherent still-life group on the same surface
requirements: every scent-bearing motif must belong to a visible input scent
every requires_scent_ids entry must also be visible
neutral support must not name a scent-bearing material
at most five large shape groups
